data.summary:
Written **[Scouts X″](vsdata:core-ability/scouts)**. When pre-battle abilities are resolved, a unit whose models all have **[Scouts](vsdata:core-ability/scouts)** may take 1 of 3 options:

- If it is in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**, set it up anywhere entirely inside your deployment zone.
- If it is entirely inside your deployment zone, make a **[scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move)** as 24.32 describes.
- If it is aboard a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** entirely inside your deployment zone and every model aboard has **[Scouts](vsdata:core-ability/scouts)**, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** may make a [scout move](vsdata:core-rule/scout-move).

options.action: set up wholly within own deployment zone

options.if: unit wholly within own deployment zone
unit embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT wholly within own deployment zone and every embarked model has Scouts
options.action: that DEDICATED TRANSPORT makes a scout move
